Method of Attack: Used in early stages of an attack to activate a downloader for the final payload in a malicious chain reaction
Contains code to search for and bypass Kaspersky and Bitdefender antivirus solutions for x86 and x64 platforms
Pushes another malware on the compromised machine which drops the final payload
Dropper fingerprints the system and sends details about the user and running processes
Uses insecure encryption (512-bit RSA) and recycled SSL certificate enabling correlation with other attacks
